summary: Frontend-only retest of the Find Home fixes from iteration_79. Tested at 390x844 on the public URL as demo@amass.africa, in 7 Playwright runs. Measured: the segment bottom is 126, the pill top is 714, and the card top is 391 (419 for a card without the Verified row). FIX-A PASS. (a) All, then fab-zoom-out once: the pill reads '6 homes in view'. That is cluster 3 [141,452] + pin ₦285M [217,356] + cluster 2 [26,630]. Cluster 13 [112,685-737] sits under the pill and is NOT counted. Cluster 44, ₦310M (x 303-402) and ₦950M are clipped and also not counted. (b) Tap ₦285M, then close: the pill reads '1 home in view · Explore wider'. ₦310M is clipped at the right edge (x 318-417) and is excluded. Explore wider gives 143 = 131+8+3+₦140M. FIX-B PASS: apply-filters-btn is at (24,774) 342x54 with no scrolling. The sections scroll inside the sheet (scrollHeight 1029 vs 552) and Apply stays fixed. reset-filters-btn exists. Bedrooms 3+ shows 'Show results (1)'. Apply closes the sheet and refetches map/markers?bedrooms=3, and the map shows ₦420M. Reset followed by Apply refetches without the filter. FIX-C PASS: the Market filter sheet (FIXA section) has filter-apply at (16,769) 358x52 on screen. The content scrolls (1295 vs 675) and Apply stays fixed. NEW BUG in that sheet: the 'Max ₦' price input runs from x 278 to 503, so 113px are off-screen. FIX-D PASS: tapping cluster 131 after Explore wider splits it into 106 [170,425], 21 [140,385], 2 [141,233] and 2 [291,161]. All are below 126 and above 714, and the count is 131. Minor: cluster '2' [291-337, 161-207] touches fab-locate (x 330-378, y 196-244), and the discs of 21 and 106 overlap by about 22x12px. FIX-E PASS for the cases I could reproduce. Low pins glide clear: ₦8.5M/yr moved from 564-612 to 225-279, and another Rent pin from 459-507 to 225-279. Both are 99px below the segment and 112px above the card. A high pin at 163-211 did not need a glide and stays 34px below the segment. I could not test the glide for a label that sits 0-16px under the segment: in 3 attempts I found no pin whose bottom was between 128 and 190. A pin whose label was hidden behind the search chrome (82-130) could not be tapped, which is expected. FIX-F PASS: 'Search this area' stays hidden after Explore wider (checked at +300ms, +700ms and +2.5s) and after a cluster tap. It appears after a manual fab zoom. Regression PASS: the Rent fit shows 8 (= 4 pins + 2 + 2, all inside). The Lease fit shows 2. Searching 'Abuja' re-fits and shows 8, all inside. Exactly one card opens and closes. The teaser reads 'Terrace · Abuja · approx.' with 'Unlock · 60 MASS', and no street is shown. The map state is kept after Market → Find Home. MINOR: (1) The count assumes every label is 124px wide (PIN_HALF_W=62), but labels are drawn 100px wide. So the initial All view shows ₦285M fully drawn at x 288-388 while the pill says 3 instead of 4. That pin is also partly behind the fab-zoom-out button. (2) There is no re-fit on an intent change when some pin is already in the band, and this applies to Buy as well as All. Repro: Rent, tap pins (they glide), Lease, then Buy. The pill shows 92, but cluster 17 [88,79-131] and ₦95M [108,111-159] are left under the search bar. (3) Neither the fit nor the count accounts for the FAB column: ₦135M [264-364, 222-270] in Buy and ₦285M in the initial All view sit behind the FABs. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, the 'Max ₦' TextInput overflows the sheet. It spans x 278-503 on a 390px screen, so the right 113px are off-screen. RN-web's <input> has an intrinsic min-width, so flex:1 does not shrink it. Fix: add minWidth: 0 to styles.priceInput. Reference: src/components/marketplace/MarketFilterSheet.tsx:416

A single pin counts only if x ± PIN_HALF_W (62) is inside the screen, but the drawn labels are about 100px wide. In the initial All view, ₦285M is drawn fully at x 288-388, yet the pill says '3 homes' while 4 are drawn. Use the real label width, or treat the FAB column as an exclusion. Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:392, src/components/map/PricePin.tsx:26

issues: Neither regionFor nor the count avoids the right-side FAB column (x 330-378, y 196-360). ₦135M (Buy, x 264-364, y 222-270) and ₦285M (initial All, y 338-386) are partly hidden behind fab-locate, fab-zoom-in and fab-zoom-out. After a cluster tap, cluster '2' [291,161-207] touches fab-locate.

Switching intent does not re-fit while any pin is already in the band, and this applies to Buy as well. Repro: Rent, tap 2 pins, Lease, Buy. Cluster 17 [88,79-131] and ₦95M [108,111-159] are left under the search bar and segment while the pill reads 92.
A cluster tap can produce child discs that overlap: 21 [140-192, 385-437] and 106 [170-228, 425-483].

The selected pin scales by 1.12 around its centre. A pin that is not glided, with its anchor just at minY (190), ends up with its label about 13px below the segment, not 16px. Only pins that are glided are guaranteed the 16px gap. This was not observed in practice.

action_items: MEDIUM: MarketFilterSheet priceInput: add minWidth: 0 (web) so the Max ₦ input fits the 390px width.
LOW: in-view count / glide: use the measured label width (about 100px) instead of PIN_HALF_W=62, or exclude the FAB column rect explicitly, so that the count matches what can be read.
LOW: regionFor sideFrac: add the FAB column width (about 60px plus half a label) on the right side for rows y 196-360, or shift the fit left, so pins do not land behind the FABs.
LOW (product call): consider re-fitting when an intent change leaves markers under the chrome, not only when nothing is in the band (Lease → Buy repro).
Optional: add testIDs to the Bedrooms/Bathrooms chips in FilterSheet and to the Market PriceInput for testing.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 929 lines. It should be split: map helpers (regionFor, project, clearBand, the count) into a hook, and the status pills into components.
The cluster onPress handler is defined inline in the clusters.map render. It is fine functionally, but could be extracted into a helper.
exploreWider: programmaticUntil is 800ms for a 600ms animation, which is OK. The cluster tap uses 600ms for a 380ms animation, which is OK.

success_rate.frontend: about 90%: FIX-A to FIX-F pass, 1 new MEDIUM UI bug and 3 LOW layout nits

seed_data_creation: None. No MASS spent and nothing unlocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport 390x844: segment bottom 126, pill top 714, card top 391 (419 for a shorter card), FAB column x 330-378, y 196-360. /app/tests/i80_helpers.py has login() and DUMP_JS. Load it with exec(open(...).read(), globals()) in browser_automation. DUMP_JS returns the drawn boxes, a CLIPPED flag, the readable sum, the pill text and the Search this area state. The initial All view shows ₦285M plus cluster 3 (pill 3). Explore wider gives 143, and the cluster tap 131 splits into 106/21/2/2. The Market filter sheet is only available in the FIXA/Declutter sections (mkt-tab-fixa → market-filter-btn). The web map has no drag panning, so only the FABs change the region.
rca_of_issue: Market Max input overflow: RN-web renders TextInput as an <input>, which has an intrinsic width of about 20 characters. With flex:1 and no minWidth:0, two inputs plus the dash exceed the row width. Count undercount: the count uses the constant PIN_HALF_W=62, which is the maximum label width, while most labels are about 100px wide.
